block.index_tts.workflow: Synthesize English or Chinese from text and a local voice reference. Prepare the model and Python environment first. Model licenses differ from the block license.
block.index_tts.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.index_tts.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.index_tts.invalid_config: Check the IndexTTS-2 settings and limits.
block.index_tts.model.title: IndexTTS-2
block.index_tts.model.description: Synthesize complete speech files locally with IndexTTS-2 and a required voice reference.
block.index_tts.help_asset_directory: Prepare the pinned 7.66 GB IndexTTS-2 and auxiliary snapshots. Runtime only reads verified local files; no downloads.
block.index_tts.help_environment_python: Dedicated Linux Python 3.10/3.11 environment with the pinned Index SDK. Empty uses the app interpreter, only if compatible; nothing is installed automatically.
block.index_tts.help_reference_audio: Required at synthesis time: finalized, non-silent local clip of 0.5–15 seconds, at most 32 MiB. Use only a voice you are authorized to reproduce.
block.index_tts.help_output_directory: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names; no overwrites or automatic deletion.
block.index_tts.help_emotion: Keep the reference delivery or request one of the model’s eight emotion directions. English and Chinese only; no text-to-emotion model.
block.index_tts.help_device: CUDA is recommended for interactive use. CPU is explicit and slow; unavailable CUDA never silently falls back.
block.index_tts.help_format: Complete Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz or PCM WAV at 22.05 kHz. No direct live audio stream.
block.index_tts.help_temperature: Official model sampling control. Higher values increase variation; not a voice identity selector.
block.index_tts.help_top_k: Number of candidate audio tokens retained by the official sampler.
block.index_tts.help_precision: Float32 on CPU or CUDA. Float16 requires CUDA; CPU plus float16 is refused rather than silently changed.
block.index_tts.help_threads: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.
block.index_tts.help_max_audio_sec: Reject the entire result if it exceeds this duration. Each segment must also end naturally before its token limit.
block.index_tts.help_max_text_chars: Reject oversized text. The model also enforces its own combined text/audio token window.
block.index_tts.help_timeout_sec: Verification, model loading, synthesis and publication must finish within this deadline; at most 240 seconds for managed execution.
block.index_tts.help_memory_limit_mib: Optional Linux virtual-address ceiling: 0 disables it; otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA can reserve large virtual ranges. Not a RAM/VRAM reservation.
block.index_tts.help_min_available_ram_m: Refuse loading below this available-RAM threshold. Default 16 GiB; this check does not reserve memory or guarantee GPU capacity.
block.index_tts.help_max_pending: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the current job and clears earlier pending requests.
block.index_tts.help_top_p: Nucleus-sampling probability for the main audio-code generator.
block.index_tts.help_repetition_penalty: Official Index autoregressive-code repetition penalty. Default 10; not a guarantee against repeated speech.
block.index_tts.help_emotion_strength: Used only when choosing a specific emotion. Zero uses the reference conditioning; exact perceived expression is not guaranteed.
block.index_tts.help_max_mel_tokens: A segment must end with the native stop token. Exhaustion rejects the whole file; nothing is cut and labelled complete.
block.index_tts.help_max_segment_tokens: Official tokenizer’s segment target; punctuation grouping may produce a longer segment. The total number of segments is separately bounded.
block.index_tts.help_max_segments: Reject text requiring more segments before audio generation. Every expected segment must finish before publication.
block.index_tts.help_interval_silence_ms: Silence inserted by the official SDK between synthesized text segments; included in the total audio duration.
